def specialconvolve(a: Integer[Array, '16 16']):
    bprobe_trace = []
    bprobe_v0 = a[1:-1, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((8, bprobe_v0))
    bprobe_v1 = a[:-2, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((11, bprobe_v1))
    bprobe_v2 = bprobe_v0 + bprobe_v1
    bprobe_trace.append((9, bprobe_v2))
    bprobe_v3 = a[2:, :]
    bprobe_trace.append((12, bprobe_v3))
    bprobe_v4 = bprobe_v2 + bprobe_v3
    bprobe_trace.append((10, bprobe_v4))
    rowconvol = bprobe_v4
    bprobe_v5 = rowconvol[:, 1:-1]
    bprobe_trace.append((0, bprobe_v5))
    bprobe_v6 = rowconvol[:, :-2]
    bprobe_trace.append((4, bprobe_v6))
    bprobe_v7 = bprobe_v5 + bprobe_v6
    bprobe_trace.append((1, bprobe_v7))
    bprobe_v8 = rowconvol[:, 2:]
    bprobe_trace.append((5, bprobe_v8))
    bprobe_v9 = bprobe_v7 + bprobe_v8
    bprobe_trace.append((2, bprobe_v9))
    bprobe_v10 = a[1:-1, 1:-1]
    bprobe_trace.append((7, bprobe_v10))
    bprobe_v11 = 9 * bprobe_v10
    bprobe_trace.append((6, bprobe_v11))
    bprobe_v12 = bprobe_v9 - bprobe_v11
    bprobe_trace.append((3, bprobe_v12))
    colconvol = bprobe_v12
    return bprobe_trace
